name: Orbit
header:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<VTKFile type="ImageData" version="0.1" byte_order="LittleEndian" compressor="vtkZLibDataCompressor">
  <RD format_version="3">
    <description>This is an rd formula that uses an iteration step inspired by an orbits-fractal step (eg Mandelbrot/Julia). It treats reagents a and b as a complex number (a+bi) and raises it to a complex power. It also includes a number of other tweaks.
	
This example generates waves with sharp peaks in the magnitude (c reagent). Waves sometimes form spiral nucleation centers, and usually all end up travelling in the same direction.
    </description>
    <rule name="Orbit" type="formula" wrap="1" neighborhood_type="vertex" neighborhood_range="1" neighborhood_weight="laplacian">
      <param name="timestep">
        0.05
      </param>
      <param name="clampMin">
        -2
      </param>
      <param name="clampMax">
        2
      </param>
      <param name="constReal">
        -0.09
      </param>
      <param name="constImag">
        0.04
      </param>
      <param name="constRealInner">
        -0.87
      </param>
      <param name="constImagInner">
        -0.3
      </param>
      <param name="realPower">
        1.2
      </param>
      <param name="imagPower">
        -1
      </param>
      <param name="D_a">
        0.12
      </param>
      <param name="D_b">
        0.35
      </param>
      <param name="unDa_b">
        1
      </param>
      <param name="unDb_a">
        -0.5
      </param>
      <param name="mag_amp">
        1
      </param>
      <param name="mag_power">
        1
      </param>
      <param name="mag_zeroPt">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="phaseOffset">
        0.4
      </param>
      <param name="phaseAmp">
        1
      </param>
      <param name="eConst">
        2.71828
      </param>
      <formula number_of_chemicals="4">
        c = pow((a+constRealInner)*(a+constRealInner) + (b+constImagInner)*(b+constImagInner), mag_power) * mag_amp + mag_zeroPt;
d = atan2( b+constRealInner, a+constRealInner ) * phaseAmp + phaseOffset;
delta_a = clamp( timestep * pow( c, realPower) * pow( eConst, -imagPower*d ) * cos( imagPower * log( c ) + realPower * d ) + D_a * laplacian_a - unDa_b * laplacian_b + constReal, clampMin, clampMax );
delta_b = clamp( timestep * pow( c, realPower) * pow( eConst, -imagPower*d ) * sin( imagPower * log( c ) + realPower * d ) + D_b * laplacian_b - unDb_a * laplacian_a + constImag, clampMin, clampMax );
      </formula>
      
    </rule>
    <initial_pattern_generator apply_when_loading="true">
      <overlay chemical="a">
        <overwrite>
        </overwrite>
        <white_noise low="-0.9" high="-9.05">
        </white_noise>
        <everywhere>
		</everywhere>
      </overlay>
      <overlay chemical="b">
        <overwrite>
        </overwrite>
        <white_noise low="0.7" high="5.9">
        </white_noise>
        <everywhere>
		</everywhere>
      </overlay>
    </initial_pattern_generator>
	
    <render_settings>
      <surface_color r="1" g="1" b="1">
        
      </surface_color>
      <color_low r="0" g="0" b="0">
        
      </color_low>
      <color_high r="1" g="1" b="1">
        
      </color_high>
      <show_color_scale value="false">
        
      </show_color_scale>
      <show_multiple_chemicals value="false">
        
      </show_multiple_chemicals>
      <active_chemical value="c">
        
      </active_chemical>
      <low value="0">
        
      </low>
      <high value="15">
        
      </high>
      <vertical_scale_1D value="30">
        
      </vertical_scale_1D>
      <vertical_scale_2D value="30">
        
      </vertical_scale_2D>
      <contour_level value="0">
        
      </contour_level>
      <use_wireframe value="false">
        
      </use_wireframe>
      <show_cell_edges value="false">
        
      </show_cell_edges>
      <show_bounding_box value="true">
        
      </show_bounding_box>
      <slice_3D value="true">
        
      </slice_3D>
      <slice_3D_axis value="z">
        
      </slice_3D_axis>
      <slice_3D_position value="0.5">
        
      </slice_3D_position>
      <show_displacement_mapped_surface value="false">
        
      </show_displacement_mapped_surface>
      <color_displacement_mapped_surface value="true">
        
      </color_displacement_mapped_surface>
      <use_image_interpolation value="true">
        
      </use_image_interpolation>
      <timesteps_per_render value="129">
        
      </timesteps_per_render>
      
    </render_settings>
    
  </RD>
  <ImageData WholeExtent="0 511 0 511 0 0"></ImageData>
</VTKFile>
